title: Create a customer account
intro: Name, phone number, email and address are required by the platform. The address is used to show distances to markets and to pre-fill directions.

fields.emailHint: Used to sign in and for order notifications.

consent.label: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>
consent.note: Your name and phone number go to the stall you order from, so they can hand your order over on market day. You pay the Farmer at the stall.

acceptFirst: Accept the terms to create your account.
sharedAccount: One account can be shared within a family; the system does not tell people apart inside an account.

toast.failed: Could not create your account. Please try again.

errors.fullNameMax: Full name can be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Vietnamese mobile number (10 digits).
errors.emailMax: Email can be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.addressMax: Address can be at most {{max}} characters.
